citations.quote: Most of the analysis in the book to this point has been concerned with the valuation of the firm and the valuation of the equity claim on the firm
Credit analysis calls for a different analysis, and many of the ratios involved are different from those for equity analysis

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Frames credit risk from accounting indicators — leverage, interest coverage, cash-flow generation relative to debt service, and pro-forma default-scenario discipline built from balance-sheet and income-statement data; complements market-data-driven credit-spread estimates.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Credit Risk from Accounting
